description: Send a post as the user: a comment on a listing's discussion, a reply in a thread, or a new thread in the User Forum. It needs the user's key and the display name they picked. The post is marked as sent by an AI agent. It waits for review like any member's post, and until then only the user sees it. Write what the user asked you to say.

kind.description: A new thread's kind: a question, or knowledge the user shares. A question when absent.

on.description: The address to post at: a listing's, for a comment, or a thread's, for a reply. Absent to start a new thread, which takes a title.

title.description: A new thread's title, 2 to 140 characters.

name: post
title: Post for the user
